To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the fishing tourism is a new demand that has to combine with the traditional tourism demand, and that it has to be designed as a product, and not as an activity, and that it must be related with local development, in a way to be sustainable.

the new tourism demand is a combination between coastal and fishing tourism, and the main motivation of this new demand is a new way to experience nature, in addition to a new way to enjoy food and gastronomy, and a new way to know the culture of a region, and the main effects are a better understanding of fishing and the sea and an improvement in the local development.

the tourism of fishing, in its different forms (ecotourism, recreational fishing, gastronomy and cultural tourism, etc) is a new demand that has been developing during the last 10 years, and that has had positive effects in the local development of the coastal areas where it has been implanted.

fishing tourism is not a new product, but a new way to offer the old product of «sun and beaches» and a good way for local development.
